$comment: The team. Each dentist becomes a card, a /team/<slug> profile page and a direct line on the booking page. `services` lists the service slugs they perform — those service pages then show them as 'Your specialists'. A blog post whose `author` matches a dentist's name links to their profile. Every field except slug and name is optional.

section.title: The hands behind your smile.
section.intro: Every specialist here is board-certified and treats within their own discipline. You are never handed to a generalist for specialist work.

items.name: Dr. Aanya Mehta
items.bio: Founded the clinic after a decade in hospital practice, with one standard: no treatment starts until the patient can explain it back in their own words.
about: Dr. Aanya founded Demo Dental Clinic in 2009 after a decade in hospital practice, with a simple standard: no treatment starts until the patient can explain it back in their own words.

Her work centres on cosmetic and restorative dentistry — smile design, porcelain veneers and full-mouth rehabilitation — planned digitally so patients approve the result before a single tooth is prepared.

items.name: Dr. Kabir Shah
items.bio: Over 2,400 implants placed, all under CBCT-guided planning. Also handles complex extractions and bone grafting referred from other clinics.
about: Dr. Kabir has placed more than 2,400 implants, every one of them under CBCT-guided surgical planning, so the position of each fixture is decided on screen before the procedure begins.
He also manages complex extractions, bone grafting and sinus lifts — cases that are often referred to him by other clinics in the city.

items.name: Dr. Meera Krishnan
items.bio: A certified aligner provider with more than 900 finished orthodontic cases and a particular interest in adult relapse correction.
about: Dr. Meera is a certified clear-aligner provider who has finished more than 900 orthodontic cases, from teenagers' first braces to adults correcting a relapse years after treatment.
Every case starts with a cephalometric analysis and a 3D simulation, so patients see the expected result and timeline before they commit.

items.name: Dr. Rahul Menon
items.bio: Works entirely under a dental operating microscope, which is why difficult re-treatment cases are usually routed to his chair.
about: Dr. Rahul works entirely under a dental operating microscope. The magnification lets him find and clean canals that are easily missed, which is why difficult re-treatment cases are usually routed to his chair.
Most of his root canal treatments are completed in a single sitting with rotary instrumentation and an apex locator.
